RSS news feeds allow you to receive WTO news
directly to your desktop as soon as it is published, without you
having to visit the WTO website. RSS stands for Really Simple
To start using the news feeds, you will need a news reader. This
will allow you to select the WTO website as a news source. The news reader
will check the feeds and will show any new content that has been added.

Can I use WTO news feeds on my site?
We encourage dissemination of news from the WTO provided proper
attribution is given, saying WTO news. You may not use the WTO logo or
try to present the news as though it comes from another source.
